name: CapitaEdgeX
audienceShort: Indian freelancers, solopreneurs, agencies, and small businesses
audienceExtended: Indian marketing agencies, freelancers, solopreneurs, and small businesses that need stronger financial operations without enterprise overhead
mission: We build CapitaEdgeX to simplify invoicing, collections, payments, compliance, and financial operations so growing businesses can spend less time on admin and make better decisions with more clarity.
purpose: We want to reduce admin burden, improve cash flow visibility, and give users an AI CFO layer that turns financial data into practical action.
heroDescription: CapitaEdgeX is the complete Financial OS for Indian freelancers and agencies — invoicing, collections, payments, compliance, and reporting in one place.
footerDescription: The complete Financial OS for Indian freelancers and agencies — bridging the gap between revenue generation and financial operations.
faqBuiltFor: Indian freelancers, solopreneurs, agencies, and small businesses that need GST-compliant invoicing, payment tracking, collections visibility, and operational finance support without enterprise complexity.
aboutParagraphs: Welcome to CapitaEdgeX. We are a financial technology team building for Indian freelancers, solopreneurs, agencies, and small businesses.
Our mission is to simplify invoicing, collections, payments, compliance, and day-to-day financial operations so growing teams can focus on work instead of admin.
We are building CapitaEdgeX as a practical Financial OS with an AI CFO layer that helps users stay in control of cash flow, receivables, and financial decisions.
values: tools that help users take action
